slides.headline: A full net, a rising sea. Too *heavy*?
Two fishermen in a small boat, far from *land*.
One hauls the net with all his *strength*.
The other leans out to keep the boat *level*.
The net comes up silver with *herring*.
More fish still hang in the *water*.
A red float marks the rest of the *net*.
Far away, the schooner fades into the *fog*.
An oar stands up, forgotten in the *rush*.
The sea rises. Every wave rocks the heavy *boat*.
Homer watched fishermen like these in *Maine*.
A full net, a rough sea. Would *you* keep pulling?
